positive.prompt: Continue this investigation: add my follow-on question, the agent answer and new findings to its existing canonical report instead of another report
I added a repository and changed task resource settings; progressively update the same investigation report with the questions, decisions and findings
Repair fragmented reports for this task: integrate the follow-up into the original canonical report and preserve the follow-up as historical evidence
Run this existing investigation on another agent using its saved task, report and prior questions and answers without the original conversation

negative.prompt: Resolve the filename and destination for a brand-new TASK artifact
Verify E1 citations and reference completeness for this saved report
Open the existing TASK in the editor and wait for close before executing

evals.prompt: report-continuation-progressive/docs/tasks/TASK-worker-cpu.md already has an investigation report. After its first delivery I asked whether replay caused the CPU problem, the agent gave a provisional answer, I added the application repository and requested code validation; those turns are saved in report-continuation-progressive/notes/turns-after-delivery.md. We have new profiling evidence but code inspection is pending. Update the report now. Stay offline.
evals.expected_output: Resolves the existing canonical report and updates it progressively with dated questions, responses, evidence and task resource changes, leaving code validation open.
expectations: Updates the existing owned report rather than inventing a suffixed report
Records the user replay question and material provisional agent answer with its evidence/disposition
Reflects the added application repository and pending code-validation question without treating task configuration as proof of execution
Reconciles the main conclusion with observed profiling and preserves earlier alert evidence
Marks the draft and missing source/format checks as incomplete instead of delaying all report updates until final findings
Excludes unrelated editor and delivery conversation from the incident narrative

evals.prompt: In report-continuation-fragmented, the original report docs/reports/REPORT-queue-stall.md and its later follow-up cover the same incident. The task now links only the follow-up because an earlier agent added it. I explicitly select the original report as canonical. Apply continuation, keep historical artifacts, and preserve all existing resource settings. Stay offline.
evals.expected_output: Uses the explicit original report selection, integrates relevant follow-up evidence and Q&A there, and repairs the task report link without deleting the historical follow-up or rewriting task resources.
expectations: Honors explicit canonical identity over recency, suffixes and the newer task link
Integrates findings into the main conclusion and relevant sections without retaining contradictory current conclusions
Preserves the separate follow-up artifact as historical and maintains retrievable provenance
Updates only authorized task links and preserves every resource/configuration setting
Does not publish or delete artifacts implicitly

evals.prompt: In report-continuation-superseded, a follow-on question saved in notes/follow-on.md disproved the earlier replay-deadlock explanation. Update the same report. The original metrics, original accounting cutoff and original published page must remain auditable. Stay offline.
evals.expected_output: Corrects the conclusion with dated evidence, retains prior observations and identifies the superseded hypothesis while preserving historical accounting and publication boundaries.
expectations: Progressively updates the canonical report and records the new question, answer and why the hypothesis was superseded
Does not silently delete earlier evidence or change its observation window
Delegates accounting treatment to Token Usage rather than inventing new totals or rolling old usage into the new revision
Keeps external publication unchanged without publication authorization

evals.prompt: This is a different incident affecting a different environment and evidence window; I explicitly want a separate report linked to the earlier investigation.
evals.expected_output: Creates a distinct report through the naming owner with the user-selected scope and relationship rather than forcibly consolidating separate investigations.
expectations: Honors the explicit request for a distinct report and records its relationship to the earlier one
Does not overwrite the earlier investigation
States that Workflow Artifact Naming resolves the new report's name and path and that Report Authoring governs its evidence
Does not propose a numeric collision suffix (such as -2) derived from the earlier report's name

evals.prompt: For the same investigation in report-continuation-html-only, HTML is now the only selected deliverable and there is no Markdown report file. New findings just arrived in evidence/new-findings.json; continue the canonical report. Stay offline.
evals.expected_output: Maintains canonical investigation identity while updating internal content and regenerating only the selected format through its existing owners.
expectations: Does not require or create a delivered Markdown report when disabled
Distinguishes format conversion from new findings and keeps one canonical investigation identity
Regenerates selected companions from the updated content and labels stale or unverified outputs explicitly

After writing, reads the saved report back and applies the existing owners' checks (Report Authoring evidence and citation checks, the delivery contract's format checks), recording any check it could not run as pending, rather than inventing its own HTML rendering rules

evals.prompt: Use the synthetic transferred task/report package under report-continuation-transfer/. A different user runs its existing investigation. The report includes prior questions, a corrected agent answer, a user-added requirement not yet reflected in the task, and an unavailable evidence attachment. No original conversation is available. Resume the task using Report Continuation. Stay offline and preserve evidence.
evals.expected_output: Loads saved context before planning or querying, reconciles the explicit requirement, preserves the corrected answer and historical evidence, and reports the attachment gap and next feasible action.
expectations: Reads the task, canonical report, continuation record, checkpoint and necessary declared dependencies before proposing an investigation plan or issuing queries
Recovers every recorded question and its disposition, including the rationale and superseded agent answer, without inventing missing turns
Reconciles the explicit user-added requirement into the current task while leaving unaccepted agent proposals as proposals
Identifies unavailable evidence and its effect; completes independent work without claiming ready handoff or complete context
Treats the unqualified run as continuation rather than rerunning all completed checks or creating a new report
Uses the receiving user authorization and access instead of inheriting historical approvals or sessions

evals.prompt: Prepare the continuing investigation in report-continuation-handoff for another user. You have the latest turns in notes/latest-turns.md, an unanswered user question, an older report summary, and local-only evidence outside the checkout. No upload or publication is authorized. Stay offline.
evals.expected_output: Records all available investigation questions and responses, updates the resume checkpoint and dependency inventory, and describes partial transfer readiness without external writes.
expectations: Accounts for every investigation question, correction, constraint and configuration decision, marking the unanswered question pending rather than dropping it
States the coverage boundary and known missing earlier history instead of calling the summary complete
Includes established and provisional findings, attempted checks, blockers and dependency-ordered next actions in a report checkpoint linked from the task
Inventories local-only evidence as unavailable to the recipient until packaged or retrievable, even if the path is relative
Names Publish It as the owner for packaging unavailable dependencies and Report Authoring as the owner of evidence validation, in the report or the handoff summary
Uploads and publishes nothing, and copies no credential or session material into the task or report
Keeps current requirements in the task and answers/evidence/history in the report rather than duplicating a transcript

evals.prompt: Rerun the same investigation from scratch for a new observation window. Preserve the existing report and prior questions/answers; no new separate report was requested.
evals.expected_output: Honors the explicit fresh scope, separates new observations from historical findings in the same canonical report, and records which conclusions were revalidated.
expectations: Distinguishes the explicit fresh rerun from default continuation and performs only the requested current scope
Preserves historical windows, revisions, Q&A corrections and original accounting instead of relabeling old data as fresh
Records current verification results separately and reconciles any revised conclusion in the canonical report
Uses current user authorization and records unavailable source access without inheriting prior credentials
